Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

- (v) Those who retired as Group 'A' Officers, a declaration in May and November each year about (a) acceptance/non-acceptance of commercial employment within one year from the date of retirement and (b) acceptance I non-acceptance of employment under any Government outside India / an International Organization of which Government of India is not a member.
